step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture represents LG Electronics' ThinQ Cloud platform divided into four functional layers: Connectivity, Processing, Storing, and Analyzing. In the Connectivity layer, LG ThinQ smart devices connect and authenticate with AWS IoT Core. AWS IoT Core forwards incoming data requests to the Processing layer, which utilizes EC2 instances for predictable workloads and Lambda functions for serverless request processing. From the processing layer, data is routed to the Storing layer: relational data is stored in RDS, while high-scale time-series device state data is written into DynamoDB. Additional data for analytics and AI model training flows through Kinesis Data Firehose into S3, leading to the Analyzing layer featuring a Data Lake and Data Hub platform.
